title: Design System: Town of Newcastle Applicant Portal

large-title.purpose: Phone section titles, the phone step list, the home heading, result titles.

headline.purpose: Sheet titles, the outer header's "Town of Newcastle".

body.purpose: Tile labels, phone list rows, results prose, the phone's Continue, Back and Steps.

body-compact.purpose: The help line under a question, "I don't know yet", sidebar rows, errors.

footnote.purpose: Trail chips, save status, "13 of 20", the item line, the carried-answer line, captions.

group-header.purpose: Uppercase heading above an inset group, as in iOS Settings.

question.purpose: The centred question on every wizard and start screen; at most 30ch, balanced.

confirm-value.purpose: The value from the Town's map on an "Is this right?" screen; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: slider-knob
shadows.purpose: The iOS slider knob only; containers take no shadow.

motion.name: pane-push
motion.value: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), translateX(24%) and opacity 0 to rest
motion.purpose: The next question sliding in (desktop and phone); a section pushing in on a phone.

motion.name: pane-pull
motion.value: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), translateX(-24%) and opacity 0 to rest
motion.purpose: Back, or a chip, returning to an earlier question.

motion.name: tile-answer-delay
motion.purpose: Pause after a tile tap so the choice is seen before the next question.

blur.name: phone-bars
blur.purpose: The phone navigation bar (ground) and footer (row) over scrolling content.

contractDivergence: Contract gives the seal teal to selection; the build selects with the deep accent and keeps the seal teal for the follow-up dot and lot outline.
Wizard spec asks a 300 ms slide; the build slides in 250 ms.
Wizard spec puts Back in the phone bottom bar; the build puts Back only in the phone navigation bar (as the direction contract's FIRST VIEWPORT says).
Wizard spec's source line reads "Measured from the Town's map"; the build reads "From the Town's map".

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Continue and Start: the only solid teal control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); color: var(--app-on-accent, #FFFFFF); min-height: 44px; min-width: 112px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Sheet Cancel and Done, "I can't find my property", Edit, Add: teal text, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); }

components.name: Wizard Tile
components.description: Pick-one radio tile (a tap answers) or pick-several checkbox tile; chosen is a 2px accent edge on the row colour, no wash.
components.css: .ds-wt-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; max-width: 36rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-wt-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } } .ds-wt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 58px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: var(--app-row, #FFFFFF); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font-size: 17px; } .ds-wt:hover { border-color: var(--app-tertiary-label, #8A8A8E); } .ds-wt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-wt-on, .ds-wt-on:hover { border: 2px solid var(--app-accent, #0C727E); padding: 11px 15px; }

components.name: Question Screen
components.description: One centred question: item line, 22px semibold question, 15px help, then the control.
components.html:
Building 1

Which best describes this building?

If you're not sure, choose "I don't know yet".
components.css: .ds-q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 24px 0; text-align: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); } .ds-q-item { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); } .ds-q-h { margin: 0; max-width: 30ch; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-q-help { margin: 0 0 16px; min-height: 1.25rem; max-width: 46ch; font-size: 15px; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); }

components.name: Answer Trail
components.description: Answers so far as chips; carried answers dashed; one scrolling row on a phone.
components.css: .ds-trail { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-trail { flex-wrap: wrap; overflow-x: visible; } } .ds-tc { flex-shrink: 0; max-width: 18rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: var(--app-row, #FFFFFF); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font-size: 13px; } .ds-tc:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-tc-carried { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--app-tertiary-label, #8A8A8E); }

components.name: Footer with Dots
components.description: Desktop footer: 7px dots left, Back and Continue right; sticky.
components.css: .ds-foot { position: sticky; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 32px; border-top: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: var(--app-ground, #F2F2F7); font: 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 7px; margin-right: auto; } .ds-dots i { display: block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); } .ds-dots i.ds-cur { background: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); } .ds-back { min-height: 44px; min-width: 96px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font: inherit; } .ds-cont { min-height: 44px; min-width: 112px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); color: var(--app-on-accent, #FFFFFF); font: 600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-back:focus-visible, .ds-cont:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inset Group
components.description: Grouped inset list with header, hairline rows and footnote.
components.html:
Your project

What kind of work is this?
In a few sentences, what will you build?

Choose all that apply.
components.css: .ds-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; background: var(--app-ground, #F2F2F7); padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-group-h { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); } .ds-group-rows { background: var(--app-row, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); } .ds-group-f { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); }

components.name: Sidebar Step
components.description: Source-list step row with status glyph; current on the selection wash.
components.html: Your lotThe work
components.css: .ds-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 16px 12px; width: 17rem; background: var(--app-grouped-ground, #F2F2F7); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); text-decoration: none; } .ds-step:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1) 60%, transparent); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-current { background: var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Outside the wizard (review edits, sheets): two to four options side by side; selection is a wash and an accent border.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-o { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: transparent; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font-size: 15px; } .ds-seg-o:hover { background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); } .ds-seg-o:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-sel { border-color: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); background: var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled field on the opaque tertiary fill.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font: 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); }

narrative.northStar: The Settings Pane, One Question at a Time
narrative.overview: Apple's Settings grammar applied to a Town permit, asked as Setup Assistant asks: one centred question per screen sliding sideways, an answer trail of chips above, 7px dots below, a tap on a single choice answers. Sections stay in a source-list sidebar on a desktop and behind Steps on a phone. System type, system greys, the Town seal's teal in two depths; light and dark follow the device.
keyCharacteristics: One centred question per screen; a tap answers a single choice
Two panes at 1024px and up; navigation bar and fixed footer below
One accent hue in two depths; chosen tile is a 2px accent edge

rules.name: The Two Teals Rule
rules.body: Text and control teal is the deep accent (lifted accent-text in dark); the seal teal marks identity and never carries text.

rules.name: The Edge Not Block Rule
rules.body: Choice is an accent edge, never a solid teal block: 2px on a wizard tile; wash plus 1px edge on segments, chips, picker tiles and the current sidebar row.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Text is the device's system face at 30/22/17/15/13; no other family is loaded.

rules.name: The One Question Rule
rules.body: One 22px semibold question per screen, one 15px help line beneath, its slot held when empty.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Containers never take a drop shadow; depth comes from ground, row and elevated row.

dos: Do ask one question per screen, centred, with at most one line of help.
Do let a single choice answer at a tap; Continue only where a tap cannot finish.
Do show progress with the trail above and 7px dots below.
Do give every interactive target at least 44px; tiles 58px.
Do use the --app-* variables, never literal hex.
Do keep the section sidebar at 1024px and up, Steps one tap away below.
donts: Don't drop-shadow a container; raise a sheet by tone.
Don't set text in the seal teal.
Don't fill a chosen tile with solid teal.
Don't put a building or addition, or page dots, in a sheet.
Don't load a web font or display face.
